title: Reference arithmetic and escape lifetimes reconstruct text glyph drawing
claim: DrawTextGlyphs is a new 508-byte matching C range (506-byte symbol plus 2 alignment). Reference palette+(escapeIndex+escapeBase) grouping, separate escape-address/base lifetimes and direct special-glyph stores reproduce the shared bracket tail without goto or spills. Word-sized public arguments with explicit byte/halfword locals retain caller and callee code. ParseDecimalStr is centralized unchanged. Physical VRAM tile addresses use named screenblock/row constants; row-as-pointer placeholders are removed. A documented subtraction of a negated bounded glyph index preserves two otherwise differing operand-order bytes. There are no new pins, barriers or assembly fallbacks.
